description.narrative: A key challenge for South Africa is the transition in the electricity sector, seeking early investment in and preparing for mitigation in hard-to-mitigate sectors, and addressing the economic and social consequences of the transition: domestic coal fuelled 88% of South Africa’s electricity generation in 2019.Therefore, to solve this and related challenges, the Just Energy Transition (JET) initiative was launched. Also, coal powered stations have to be closed down in the future, one of them in Grootvlei, Mpumalanga.The Netherlands supports creation of alternative jobs. People in the area are not aware of the implications of the closure and future opportunities.Therefore, the overall result of this project is to strengthen the interrelationships, knowledge and awareness of economic opportunities of Just Economy Transition (JET) of the main stakeholders in the Grootvlei area and to create commitment for the creation of sustainable jobs by repurposing the Grootvlei by sustainable and climate smart, labour intensive agricultural production.
